name: Tama Go Musume Ikusei Monogatari
source:
Spend 100 days living with two “Egg Girls” in a gentle, bittersweet romance visual novel where four emotions—Affection, Empathy, Comfort, and Tension—gradually shape dialogue, distance, events, and endings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847890]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一部温柔、苦乐参半的浪漫视觉小说中，与两个“蛋女孩”一起生活100天，四种情感——慈爱、同理心、舒适和紧张——逐渐塑造对话、距离、事件和结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847890]Steam[/url]]
